title: Quick Vietnamese Amaretti Fried Rice
description: A delicious and creamy Vietnamese-inspired fried rice dish made with amaretti, featuring floral notes from fresh herbs and a boost of protein from scrambled eggs. Perfect for a quick and healthy weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: scrambled eggs
ingredients.notes: beaten eggs cooked to desired doneness

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the crushed amaretti cookies and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.
Add the cooked jasmine rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the skillet and add a little more oil if necessary.
Scramble the eggs in the empty side of the skillet and cook until desired doneness.
Mix the eggs into the rice mixture and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the grated ginger and stir-fry for another minute.
Stir in the chopped scallions, cilantro, chicken broth, and tofu.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is heated through.
Season with fish sauce, if using, and serve hot.
